description: Hand audit of 40 findings the ground-truth judge classed as 'valid_unseeded', sampled uniformly at random (random.Random(7).shuffle over all such findings in runs/suite/main/*/gt_scores.json, 18 runs). Single annotator (the benchmark author), checked against the site source, captured text and screenshots.

labels.valid: a real problem with the site or its output
labels.valid_overlaps_seeded: real, but it is (part of) a seeded defect
labels.debatable: true observation whose status as a defect is a judgement call
labels.wrong: false, or not a problem of the site

items.title: character_consistency
items.evidence: The pictured child has no visible brown curly hair, freckles, or green wellies.
items.label: valid
items.note: Illustrations use only the hair colour from 'What do they look like?'; curls, freckles and wellies are never drawn.

items.title: coherence
items.evidence: "The End" appears before the unfinished final sentence and then appears again.
items.label: valid
items.note: 'The End' is drawn in the end-page picture and printed again after the cut-off sentence.

items.title: input fidelity: missing
items.evidence: the importance of family togetherness
items.label: valid
items.note: The generator ignores the 'memory or idea' text entirely (story.js never reads it).

items.title: input fidelity: missing
items.evidence: The central event of building sandcastles never appears.
items.label: valid
items.note: Memory text ignored.

items.title: input fidelity: missing
items.evidence: Linh's long black hair with a red ribbon and round cheeks
items.label: valid
items.note: Appearance input ignored apart from hair colour.

items.title: language
items.evidence: The page does not explain the page-count difference between the “Preview · 9 pages” and the “20 glossy pages” hardcover.
items.label: valid
items.note: Pricing promises '20 glossy pages'; the preview has 9 pages.

items.title: fidelity
items.evidence: The woods, threatening shadows and red balloon are not connected to the supplied school-gate memory.
items.label: valid_overlaps_seeded
items.note: True, but the red balloon and threatening shadows are seeded O7/O9.

items.title: input fidelity: changed
items.evidence: The intended personal ending became an incomplete thought about looking at the sky
items.label: valid_overlaps_seeded
items.note: True; the incomplete ending is seeded O13, the ignored memory is not.

items.title: language
items.evidence: “skipped all way home” is missing the word “the” and should be “skipped all the way home”.
items.label: wrong
items.note: Hallucinated error: the captured text reads 'skipped all the way home'.

items.title: visual_quality
items.evidence: The picture is essentially a repeat of the cover rather than a new illustration for the resolution.
items.label: valid
items.note: The page-8 picture is the cover composition again (same sky, sun, ground and child).

items.title: character_consistency
items.evidence: Aarav is drawn in a plain teal top rather than the supplied “red dinosaur t-shirt.”
items.label: valid
items.note: The child's shirt is always teal; the supplied 'red dinosaur t-shirt' is ignored.

items.title: language
items.evidence: "in the beach" is ungrammatical; standard wording is "at the beach."
items.label: valid
items.note: Template 'Once upon a time, in {place}' yields 'in the beach'.

items.title: input fidelity: missing
items.evidence: the shared experience of making the lantern
items.label: valid
items.note: Memory text ignored.

items.title: coherence
items.evidence: The story suddenly changes from a school morning to a dark forest and introduces a balloon without setup.
items.label: valid_overlaps_seeded
items.note: True, but the abrupt forest/balloon scene is seeded O7/O9.

items.title: language
items.evidence: The sentence says “in the river in Hoi An ... there lived a curious child,” which is grammatically and physically misleading.
items.label: valid
items.note: Template yields 'in the river in Hoi An, there lived a curious child'.

items.title: text_image_fit
items.evidence: The text says Lily “gazed upward”, but the image shows her face and eyes looking straight ahead.
items.label: valid
items.note: Minor but true: the text says the child gazed upward; the drawn child looks straight ahead.

items.title: text_image_fit
items.evidence: The text describes shadows growing teeth and whispering, but the picture contains only calm trees with no teeth or visible danger.
items.label: debatable
items.note: True that no teeth are drawn, but a calmer picture than the text is arguably not a defect.

items.title: input fidelity: missing
items.evidence: BR-200L reading level
items.label: valid_overlaps_seeded
items.note: The book ignores the chosen reading level: seeded O8 (age-inappropriate vocabulary).

items.title: input fidelity: changed
items.evidence: The central sandcastle-building activity became unrelated fantasy and horror events
items.label: valid_overlaps_seeded
items.note: Memory ignored; the horror element is seeded O9.

items.title: Data retention and deletion are unspecified
items.evidence: “Uploaded images may be retained to improve our services”
items.label: valid
items.note: The privacy page says uploads may be retained and shared with partners and never mentions deletion.

items.title: input fidelity: changed
items.evidence: The daytime festival atmosphere became an unexplained mixture of day, night, rain, and sunshine
items.label: valid_overlaps_seeded
items.note: Day/evening/rain/night/sunset jumble is real; rain-vs-sun is seeded O10.

items.title: Delivery estimate and address requirements are missing
items.evidence: The page shows “Shipping & handling £12.99” and a single textbox [7] “Address”, with no delivery date or address guidance.
items.label: valid
items.note: Checkout has one 'Address' box and no delivery estimate.

items.title: input fidelity: missing
items.evidence: Clear confirmation about premium gift wrap
items.label: wrong
items.note: Gift-wrap confirmation is a checkout matter (seeded U14), not missing book content.

items.title: Paid regeneration control is prominent beside ordering
items.evidence: [8] button "Regenerate entire book – $4.99" appears immediately beside the orange “Order hardcover” link.
items.label: debatable
items.note: True placement of the paid 'Regenerate entire book - $4.99' button; whether it is a defect is a design judgement (related to seeded U13).

items.title: input fidelity: missing
items.evidence: The family-pride message
items.label: valid
items.note: Memory text ignored.

items.title: text_image_fit
items.evidence: The cover title calls the story “The Magical Adventrue of Sam,” while the image is a static child beside generic water and land with no visible magic or beach activity.
items.label: valid
items.note: Generic cover picture with no magic or beach activity.

items.title: input fidelity: missing
items.evidence: Bà Nội's grey hair in a bun
items.label: valid_overlaps_seeded
items.note: The second character never appears: seeded O5.

items.title: No visible reminder that the entered family details can be reviewed
items.evidence: The page only says “Your story” and does not show Linh or Bà Nội’s saved details.
items.label: valid
items.note: The wizard goes from the photo step straight to generation with no review of the entered details.

items.title: fidelity
items.evidence: The promised subject, Conker, and Grandpa Harold are absent from the cover, as are the Christmas gift and Lily riding across the Norfolk fields.
items.label: partly_wrong
items.note: Conker (a rocking horse) is drawn on the cover as a horse; Grandpa Harold's absence is seeded O5; the ignored memory is real.

items.title: Generated cover does not reflect the supplied character details
items.evidence: I entered “blond straight hair, gap in his front teeth, yellow raincoat,” but the cover shows Nikolai with blond hair, no visible gap in his front teeth, and no yellow raincoat.
items.label: valid
items.note: Appearance input ignored apart from hair colour.

items.title: input fidelity: changed
items.evidence: The requested warm family memory became a dark fantasy adventure.
items.label: valid
items.note: Memory ignored; the book turns into a dark fantasy.

items.title: Navigation wraps awkwardly on a phone
items.evidence: The header visibly splits “How it works,” “My books,” and “Log out” across awkward lines.
items.label: valid
items.note: Screenshot confirms the header links wrap mid-label on the phone.

items.title: Page content appears below the cover image rather than as a clear page-reading area
items.evidence: The page lists “The Magical Adventrue of Lily,” “A StoryHearth original,” and the style after the cover image.
items.label: debatable
items.note: At 200% zoom the picture stacks above the text; a layout preference rather than a clear defect.

items.title: Payment form asks for sensitive information before order review
items.evidence: The visible form includes “Card number”, “Expiry”, and “CVC”, followed by a “Pay now” button.
items.label: debatable
items.note: The order summary is shown above the card fields on the same page; there is no separate review step.

items.title: visual_quality
items.evidence: The end page repeats a generic character template rather than providing a meaningful final family illustration.
items.label: valid
items.note: End page reuses the generic child template.

items.title: input fidelity: changed
items.evidence: Margaret's father is changed into 'Grandpa' as the kite's maker
items.label: wrong
items.note: Blames the site for the persona's own input: the object it typed was 'the blue kite made from Grandpa's old blue shirt'.

items.title: text_image_fit
items.evidence: The closing memory concerns looking at the sky, but the picture contains no visible sky detail and none of the people or objects needed to carry the family memory.
items.label: debatable
items.note: The end page has a sunset gradient sky but nothing else; 'no visible sky detail' is overstated.

items.title: input fidelity: missing
items.evidence: The requested personal memory does not form the plot.
items.label: valid
items.note: Memory text ignored.

items.title: text_image_fit
items.evidence: The text says Lily skipped home, but the image shows her standing still in the same generic daytime setting; no destination, Conker or Harold is shown.
items.label: valid_overlaps_seeded
items.note: Static generic picture is real; Harold's absence is seeded O5.

items.title: coherence
items.evidence: The story abruptly changes from Sam loving a yellow bucket to an unexplained evening meditation with no beach activity or Grandpa Joe.
items.label: valid_overlaps_seeded
items.note: Abrupt jump is real; the ornate evening passage and missing Grandpa Joe are seeded O8/O5.
